topic: Senior eye care checklist for parents/grandparents

youtube.title: Is Thatha's vision just 'old age'? 👓 Senior eye checklist #Shorts
youtube.description:
Thatha stopped reading the newspaper. It wasn't just old age.
பெற்றோருக்கும் தாத்தா பாட்டிக்கும் கண் பரிசோதனை அவசியம்.

• After 60, the eye's lens stiffens and can slowly turn cloudy (cataract).
• Eye pressure (glaucoma) can rise with no pain, so yearly eye tests matter.
• Keep sugar and blood pressure in control: both affect the retina.
• Bright lights near steps, corridors and bathrooms help prevent falls.
• Warning signs: night glare, faded colours, bumping into things, holding things very close.
• Sudden vision loss, a painful red eye or a dark shadow = see an eye specialist the same day.

gmb.text: Is your parent's or grandparent's vision 'just old age'? After 60, the lens inside the eye stiffens and can slowly turn cloudy, and eye pressure can rise without any pain. A simple checklist helps: an eye test every year, sugar and blood pressure in control, and bright lights near steps and corridors to prevent falls. Watch for night glare, faded colours, bumping into things or holding things very close. Sudden vision loss, a painful red eye or a dark shadow over the vision needs an eye specialist the same day.
